newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway T-bill expansion gets high yield of 4.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norway T-bill expansion gets high yield of 4.3 pct.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Monday the expansion of treasury bill SS49 produced a highest yield of 4.30 percent.
The lowest yield at the ordinary auction was 4.17 percent and the weIghted average was 4.22 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 43 percent allotment.
The bank announced last Thursday the expansion of the four-month T-bill by four billion crowns. The bill was issued on July 8 at 5.5 billion crowns with 500 million crowns reserved for the bank.
SS49 has a nominal interest rate of four percent and matures on November 17, 1997.
